title.ko: 목적어를 가운데 넣는 구동사 · 분리 불가 구동사

explain.ko: 구동사는 동사 + 부사/전치사(turn on, look after)로 이루어져 새로운 뜻을 만듭니다. 목적어를 가운데 넣을 수 있는 분리형(turn on, try on, throw away, look up)은 명사 목적어는 두 자리 모두 가능하지만(turn on the TV / turn the TV on), 대명사는 반드시 가운데에 놓습니다(turn it on, not turn on it). 분리할 수 없는 구동사(look after, look for, wait for, get off)는 목적어를 항상 뒤에 둡니다(look after the dog, look after it).
explain.en: A phrasal verb is a verb + particle (turn on, look after) with a new meaning. With separable verbs (turn on, try on, throw away, look up) a noun object can go in either place (turn on the TV / turn the TV on), but a pronoun must go in the middle (turn it on, not turn on it). Inseparable phrasal verbs (look after, look for, wait for, get off) always keep the object after the particle (look after the dog, look after it).

notes.ko: 대명사 목적어는 분리형에서 가운데: turn it on. 분리 불가에서는 뒤: look after it.
notes.en: A pronoun goes in the middle of separable verbs: turn it on; after inseparable ones: look after it.

notes.ko: 같은 동사라도 전치사에 따라 뜻이 달라집니다(look up / look after / look for).
notes.en: The same verb changes meaning with different particles (look up / look after / look for).
